workspace-bound-agent-grant-01.graded_text: Each agent connection is bound to one firm workspace chosen at consent and approved by that firm's Admin, and a consultant who works for several firms makes a separate connection for each.

votes.e: B/project/docs/agent-access.md:7 "Each MCP connection is a delegation from one consultant to one agent client for exactly one firm workspace. A current Admin of that workspace must explicitly approve that connection before credentials can access workpapers."; :40 "explicitly chooses one workspace from their current memberships"; :11 "A consultant working for firms A and B connects twice, with independently approved credentials"; :41 "No access token, refresh token, usable authorization code, or workpaper data is released while pending."

workspace-bound-agent-grant-02.graded_text: The server checks on every call that the target belongs to the connection's bound workspace and that the consultant's membership and role are still live, so removal from a firm cuts off an existing connection.

votes.e: B/project/docs/agent-access.md:66-71 "For every tool invocation: ... 3. Re-establish the subject's live membership and role in the bound organization. workspace-bound-agent-grant-03.graded_text: The design offers no connection whose scope spans more than one firm.
